summary: Profile of Jim Watkins, a US Army veteran turned Philippines-based porn and web-hosting entrepreneur who took over 8chan in 2014, kept it running as mass shooters posted there in 2019, and fought to revive it after it was deplatformed.

evidence.note: Watkins born 1964 in Washington state, joins the Army in 1982
mid-1990s launch of a Japanese-market porn site, later renamed N.T. Technology
his hosting company takes on 2channel in 2000 and later seizes it
move to the Philippines in the early 2000s and his Manila business network
2014 deal: Watkins takes over 8chan servers and moves Brennan to Manila
8chan pol board becomes openly neo-Nazi and runs 2016 meme campaigns
Watkins' video response three days after the Christchurch massacre
Poway and El Paso shootings, deplatforming and congressional testimony
Brennan on r9k and Wizardchan as roots of incel communities
2019 8kun relaunch attempts and Watkins' criminal libel complaint against Brennan
Brennan recounts a racist rant by Watkins at his Filipino staff

notes: Interview episode with 8chan founder Brennan, but the bulk is a researched biography of Watkins, so deep-dive. main_span starts at the 2014 8chan takeover; his porn and 2channel businesses from the mid-1990s are setup. Shootings in NZ and US are discussed but not in graphic detail, so no content warnings. Brennan birth year 1994 inferred from his age 19 in 2013.
